description: This Java source file defines an abstract class 'GenericAsyncEngine' for handling asynchronous service execution within the Apache OFBiz framework. It includes methods for running services synchronously and asynchronously, with support for persisted jobs and job management.

classes.name: GenericAsyncEngine
classes.description: An abstract class providing asynchronous service execution capabilities, including methods for running services synchronously and asynchronously, with support for persisted jobs and job management.

methods.description: Abstract method to run a service synchronously, returning a result map.

methods.description: Abstract method to run a service synchronously without returning a result.
